title: Metriko-stage1 bootstrap adapter for QGP downstream validation
description:
**Parallel sanity check for PATCH-50's full BZK12 greedy.** While PATCH-50 fixes the cross-field, this adapter feeds metriko's known-good stage1 output (cross field + matching + seam) AS IF it were PATCH-39's output, allowing PATCH-40/41/42/43 to be validated independently of PATCH-39's correctness. Even after PATCH-50 lands this adapter is useful for regression tests against the metriko reference.

Metriko per-stage diagnostic baseline at Ixdar/ixdar-app/test/resources/qgp/baseline-hand/:
- stage1_extrinsic_field.tsv — per-face direction-field 3D vectors
- stage1_matching.txt — per-edge index 0..3
- stage1_seam.txt — seam edges (one per line)
- stage1_singular.txt — singularity vertex IDs + indices
- Hand-tri-30k.obj — input mesh

The adapter:
1. Loads  and the four diagnostic files.
2. Constructs FaceRosyField (a synthetic implementation that returns metriko-loaded θ via CombedField API) + CombedField (matching + seam from metriko).
3. Returns a FaceRosyField + CombedField + List<Singularity> tuple usable by PATCH-40 (SeamlessParameterization) and PATCH-41 (MotorcycleGraph).

When PATCH-50 lands, both bootstrap and PATCH-50's output should produce equivalent downstream T-meshes — that's the regression check.
definition-of-done: 1. MetrikoBootstrap class loads stage1 files. 2. VerifyMetrikoBootstrap CLI runs end-to-end Hand-tri-30k.obj from bootstrap → IGM → motorcycle → T-mesh. 3. PATCH-41 motorcycle graph produces > 0 valid 4-cycle patches on the bootstrapped Hand input (validates downstream is correct given good upstream). 4. Singularity count from bootstrap matches stage1_singular.txt line count.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test: load stage1 files, verify counts match. 2. Integration test: bootstrap → SeamlessParameterization → MotorcycleGraph; expect injectivity score > current cube baseline. 3. Once PATCH-50 ships: cross-check PATCH-50 vs bootstrap singularity counts on Hand (should agree within tolerance per thesis fidelity).
